full_context_review.scope: Complete actual H2 5 and9 prose and source-unit spans; no fixed section5 paragraph minimum or language-length heuristic. Cross-section applicability/meaning is independently reviewed separately.

actual_stored_projection_bodies.scope: All12 protocol fields, complete calculation/input/output, quality requirements/evidence, all measurement/property/unit bodies, source records, full row descriptions/amount evidence/basis/ranges, boundary/allocation/validation and reference fields. Literal and complete source/ancestor context checks are separate.

measurementRules.rule: Measure complete net wet toy mass using cp_release at unique first acceptance, excluding actual removable packaging tare and including all actual permanent supplied parts/water once. Released closingFG is already in Q.
Preserve each numerator native mass/energy/volume and exact reference unit chain. Mass/kg is not a universal inventory requirement; electrical MJ and atmospheric-water m3 stay distinct.

Number of items Item(s) and item are factor1 count aliases only. If per-item collection must become per-kg, independently calibrate complete same-configuration net mass M with supplied parts/moisture/scope under cp_release; never invent kg per toy or density from secondary coefficients. Integrated volume is already integrated; only rates receive time integration. Density must be measured for that actual substance/state.

This Q is mass. If geometry supports collection, measure actual single-side projection; L*W only for proven rectangles and otherwise use traceable drawing-specific or measured geometry, not bounding box or summed halves.

calculationRules.rule: Retain original readings first. Convert actual kWh to MJ by 3.6; integrate only a genuine rate over its actual interval and never multiply an already integrated volume by time. Use independent substance/state density for a required volume-to-mass conversion, never a secondary flow coefficient or guessed item mass.

Q=sum calibrated complete net kg of uniquely first-released conforming toys; retain actual permanent components and water once; exclude removable packaging and unreleased/destroyed specimens. Released closingFG is already counted.

For each exchange vector A_c=B_open+U-B_close-T_other. B covers raw/WIP and unused/unassigned nonWIP stores/service charge only, never already released FG or incurred service. U is actual new additions, not already stock-corrected consumption. T_other needs independent real other cohort/function and justified single handover; ordinary waste/sale does not qualify. If consumption is already stock-corrected use the equivalent ledger without a second stock deduction.

A_H=actual original-cohort increments+opening unused/unassigned charge-closing unused/unassigned charge-justified other-function handover. The original manufacture history is inherited once. Actual performed service is not subtracted because FG stays in store. Qc is original first-release cohort kg and H the observed horizon, not current shipment/return/reworked kg.

q=N/D once in each separate result dimension. Physical N=complete actual gross leg V_i; burden N=A_c or A_H separately. Manufacturing D=Q; actual original-cohort service and its related gross legs D=original Qc with declared H. out_toy is 1 kg reference. Q0 retains raw loads with no unit result. Cards and aggregation reference this same q without a second division, stock correction or economic scaling of V_i.

O + P + I + ER + J_in + H2O_in = C + S + EO + W + J_out + H2O_out. Every term in this physical balance is actual kg; item or m3 observations need an independently evidenced same-configuration mass or actual substance/state density conversion, while the original inventory exchange keeps its native unit. O and C are complete actual wet opening/closing empty, attached-WIP, attached-FG and reusable stocks. P/I/ER are disjoint whole-article inward legs; S is gross outward shipment, EO external return sent, W the actual whole wet discard. ER is external return received. J_in/J_out are independently measured non-water repair, replacement, residue or other material transfers across this packaging-pool boundary not already in those whole-article legs. H2O_in/H2O_out are independently measured actual water transfers across this pool boundary not already embodied in those legs; include natural adsorption/desorption without any repair. Split wet added/removed material into disjoint non-water J and H2O; no prescribed composition or density. Full wet W includes substrate/retained residues/water once, so its nested components are not additional J_out or H2O_out unless physically separated before the boundary. Matched internal pool transfers cancel on foreground consolidation and create no extra purchase, service or Q. Internal reuse/attachment cancels. Retain complete wet stocks and real retained ingress together. X only deduplicates other same-side incoming/outgoing terms. Mixed origin W is not added to the complete mixed outlet.

Manufacture: opening raw/WIP + actual disjoint incoming material/water/species = closing raw/WIP/unassigned stores + first-release Q + real waste/species outputs. FG/service: opening complete FG + internal Q handoff + external gross returns + disjoint new parts/water = closing FG/repairWIP + gross dispatch/external returns + real waste/species. Reconcile packaging/assets/fluids separately, then cancel all matched internal pairs once; Q plus closing releasedFG is not double production. Every actual packaging pool uses the complete disjoint J_in/J_out and H2O_in/H2O_out wet balance in calc_pack; duplicate observations cannot remove C or real increments.

Independently reconcile whole wet/dry mass and relevant elements against evidenced species/phase/reaction states. No single residual fits two unknowns; preserve each independently measured gas gross inlet/outlet, moisture event and non-additive mixture bridge. Do not derive molecules from COD/VOC/PM/total element indicators.

measurementRules.rule: 采用 cp_release 在唯一首次接受时量测完整湿态净玩具，扣实际可拆包装皮重，实际永久随供件和水仅一次；已放行期末成品已在 Q 内。
保留每分子的原生质量、能量、体积及精确参考单位链，Mass/kg 不是通用清单要求，电 MJ 及空气水 m3 分开。
Number of items 的 Item(s) 与 item 仅因子1计数同单位。如每件采集需转每 kg，依 cp_release 对相同完整配置、随供件、水分及范围独立校准净质量 M；不得编每件 kg 或从次级系数推密度。积分体积已积分，仅速率需积分，密度须该真实物质状态量测。
本 Q 为质量；若几何辅助采集，须真实单面投影，L*W 仅适用已证矩形，否则依可追溯图纸或实测几何，不用包围框或双片面积之和。

calculationRules.rule: 先保留原始读数。实际 kWh 乘 3.6 转 MJ；仅真正速率依真实区间积分，已积分体积不再乘时间。需要体积转质量时须独立物质状态密度，不用次级流系数或猜测件重。
Q=唯一首次放行合格玩具校准完整净 kg 之和；真实永久部件和水仅一次，排除可拆包装及未放行或破坏样品；已放行期末成品已计入。
逐交换向量 A_c=B_open+U-B_close-T_other。B 仅含原料、在制及未用未分配非在制物料或服务费用，不含已放行成品或已执行服务。U 为真实新增，不是已库存修正消耗；T_other 须真实独立其他批次或功能及正当一次移交，普通废物或销售不适用。若消耗已库存修正，采用等价账，不二扣库存。
A_H=原批次真实增量+期初未用未分配费用-期末未用未分配费用-正当其他功能移交。原制造历史只继承一次；已执行服务不因成品在库而扣除。Qc 是原首次放行批次 kg，H 是观测期，不是当期发运、退回或重工 kg。
每个独立结果维度仅执行一次 q=N/D。实物 N=完整实际毛方向 V_i，负荷 N 另为 A_c 或 A_H。制造 D=Q；原批次实际服务及其相关毛流 D=原 Qc 并声明 H。out_toy 为 1 千克参考。Q0 保留未除负荷，不出单位结果。卡片和汇总引用同一次 q，不再除、不库存修正或经济缩放 V_i。

O + P + I + ER + J_in + H2O_in = C + S + EO + W + J_out + H2O_out。本实物等式各项均为真实 kg；item 或 m3 观测须通过独立有据的同配置质量或真实物质状态密度换算，原清单交换仍保留其原生单位。O、C 为真实完整湿态期初期末空、附在制、附成品及周转库存。P/I/ER 是互斥整物品入向；S 为毛发运，EO 为向外返还，W 为真实整湿废弃物；ER 为收到外部返还。J_in/J_out 是独立实测、跨本包装池且尚未包含于上述整物品方向的非水修理、替换、残留或其他材料转移。H2O_in/H2O_out 是独立实测、跨本池且尚未内含于上述方向的真实水转移，含没有任何修理的自然吸解湿。新增或移除湿材料拆为互斥非水 J 与 H2O，不预设组成或密度。完整湿态 W 已含基材、留存残余及水一次；除非边界前真实分离，其嵌套组分不再列 J_out 或 H2O_out。已配对内部池转移在前景合并时抵消，不新增采购、服务或 Q。内部复用附着抵消，完整湿存量与真实留存入流同时保留。X 仅去重同侧其他入出项；混合来源 W 不加到已完整混合出口。

制造门：期初原料在制 + 真实互不重叠物料水物种入流 = 期末原料在制未分配存量 + 首次 Q + 真实废物物种出流。成品服务门：期初完整成品 + 内部 Q 交接 + 外部毛返还 + 互不重叠新件水 = 期末成品返工在制 + 毛发运外返 + 真实废物物种。包装资产流体各自对账，再一次抵消全部内部配对；Q 与已放行期末成品不能双计生产。 每个真实包装池均采用 calc_pack 含互斥 J_in/J_out 和 H2O_in/H2O_out 的完整湿质量等式；重复观测不能冲 C 或真实增量。
整湿干质量及相关元素与已证实物种、相态及反应状态独立对账。一残差不能拟合两未知；保留逐独立量测气体毛进出、水分事件和非加和混合桥，不从 COD、VOC、PM 或总元素指标推出分子。

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 须精确原始身份及原生广延属性链和真实供方配置相容性，每张消费卡保留全部限定、官方中文名及中文名缺失披露。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整公开原件及实际供方图纸证据

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 区分完整出版原件、原生文本提取、厂商示例、技术综合及真实场址观测。制造工艺不授权 LCA 份额，不从另一产品默认配方、排放因子、寿命、密度、质量或阈值。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整原文上下文及来源专属使用评估

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 保留校准原读数、单位状态时间场址配置范围、采样不确定性、全部失败及 Q0、签认盘点和逐交换继承向量，估计不能冒充量测。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 校准、对账台账、试验放行记录及不确定性

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 一次上游、处理、服务所有权与完整实物毛量分开披露；保留实际服务期及原批次、全部未决身份供方、假设及排除阶段。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 供方链接、桥对账及真实处置证据
